_comment: Hand-written. Where each interactive panel of the Lyα course goes (Lyα DECISIONS L20; same rules as _port/interactives.json of the first course, D15, D55, D57): 'label' is a LaTeX \label of a figure or of a (sub)section of the notes; the panel is placed right after that figure or heading, or with 'at': 'end' at the end of that (sub)section's content. 'module' is notes/lya-forest/assets/interactive/<module>.js; 'notebook' is the path of the notebook in SkewerJAX (github.com/daniellopezcano/SkewerJAX, branch main) that the panel's footer links to. The tests of each panel are _port/lya/tests/<module>.test.mjs (run by _port/tools/test_lya_interactives.mjs).
